memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus explicitly made a trip-specific exception by choosing coach for this short Dallas itinerary after business-class options were surfaced first.

messages.content: I need Dallas flights for the leadership meeting. It starts Tuesday, November 18 at 1:00 p.m. and ends Thursday at noon. Depart O'Hare Tuesday morning and come back Thursday afternoon. Nonstop only; the hotel is still pending.

I found two workable round trips. American leaves ORD at 7:05 a.m., reaches DFW at 9:36 a.m., and returns Thursday at 3:05 p.m., arriving at 5:32 p.m. United leaves at 8:10 a.m., reaches DFW at 10:45 a.m., and returns at 2:35 p.m., arriving at 5:02 p.m. American is $984 in business or $447 in standard coach; United is $1,036 in business or $429 in standard coach.
Is the United arrival too tight for a 1:00 start? We do not know where the meeting is yet.

It is feasible but leaves little protection. Allowing 20 minutes to get out of DFW and up to 60 minutes by car in midday traffic puts you at the venue around 12:05 p.m. The American flight should put you there near 10:55 a.m., leaving about two hours. Its Thursday departure also gives you roughly an hour longer after the meeting ends.
Then American. For this Dallas trip, coach is fine; the business fare is not worth the difference for two short nonstop legs. What are the coach fare terms?

The $447 round-trip Main Cabin fare permits seat selection and changes without a change fee, though any fare difference applies. It is nonrefundable as cash; cancellation before departure produces an airline trip credit. One carry-on and one personal item are included. A checked bag costs $40 each way.
Any earlier Thursday flight that still works after a noon finish?

There is a 1:40 p.m. nonstop, but it would require leaving the meeting by about 11:40 a.m. The 3:05 p.m. flight is the first option that fits a noon finish with reasonable transfer and security time. I would plan to leave the eventual venue by 12:45 p.m.
Book the 7:05 Tuesday outbound and 3:05 Thursday return in coach. No checked bag.

Booked for $447.00 on American under confirmation V3K7DM: Tuesday, November 18, ORD-DFW, 7:05-9:36 a.m.; Thursday, November 20, DFW-ORD, 3:05-5:32 p.m. Both flights are nonstop in Main Cabin, with no checked bag purchased. The fare is changeable with any fare difference and cancellable for trip credit. Plan to be at O'Hare by 5:35 a.m. Tuesday and to leave the Dallas meeting venue by 12:45 p.m. Thursday. We can use the confirmed venue to choose lodging and refine the ground-transfer timing.
